# CodeArena

> Open-source, server-authoritative tank arena for developers. Write JavaScript bots, battle in a live Phaser sim, contribute on GitHub, join Discord.

Site: https://codearena-t.vercel.app/
GitHub org: https://github.com/CodeArenaT
Repo: https://github.com/CodeArenaT/CodeArenaT
Discord: https://discord.gg/wGAR7QutNH
License: MIT

## Product

- JavaScript bot controllers (synchronous: state in → discrete action out)
- Phaser bird’s-eye arena with continuous physics in a fixed 10×10 space
- Server-authoritative ticks, sandboxed execution, WebSocket matches
- Fog of war, cover, multiplayer rooms / lobby codes
- Free forever — no paid plan required

## Contribute

- Engine & simulation (TypeScript)
- Arena UX / Phaser clarity & replays
- Docs, diagrams, first issues

## Indexable pages

- / — landing overview, how it works, community CTA
- /about — product explanation and feature list
- /faq — frequently asked questions
- /contribute — open-source contribution paths and links
